title: The Khalsa Enters Kasur at Midday in Silence

blocks.text: Once the traveler's report is heard, the Singhs take it as confirmation that the earlier hukam is unfolding in real conditions. At midday noon should the Khalsa Singhs enter the city of Kasur becomes the tactical principle that organizes the whole assault.

The plan depends on discipline rather than spectacle. Without unfurling their continental emblems and beating of battle drums, the Singhs are to pass inward quietly, as if they were traders rather than an attacking force.

This page thus marks the conversion of spiritual assurance into practical stealth. The Khalsa chooses silence, timing, and deception in order to open the way for sudden violence once the city has been penetrated.
